name: A 관제 패널
layout: left headline over a full-width live app window (sidebar, in-progress list, decision dock); 3-up bordered panels; hairline grid
type: Geist + Geist Mono / Pretendard (ko), grotesk 600 tight
palette: graphite neutrals, amber lamps as the only colour, ink/white buttons
motion: lamps pulse, progress bars fill, decision card slides into the dock

name: B 근무 일지
layout: two-column editorial hero: serif headline left, timestamped squad log card right; steps as ruled rows; centred closing
type: Instrument Serif + Inter / MaruBuri + Pretendard (ko), serif display
palette: warm ink and paper, one green live light, pill buttons
motion: a new log line appears every few seconds, the last line glows green

name: C 점 하나
layout: poster split: giant stacked headline left, the decision card as the hero object over the dim squad room; full-width proof numbers band; inverted approval band
type: IBM Plex Sans + Plex Mono / IBM Plex Sans KR, 84px poster scale
palette: pure neutrals, the logo's blue dot as the only colour (lamps and Approve button)
motion: card rises over the room, Approve press, Live line

name: KV-A 새벽 조정
layout: paper page, headline then an inset rounded painting panel, real app window on its left two-thirds, the rowing crew to its right
palette: paper #EEEDE8, ink, painting in slate blue, grey and dawn ochre
motion: the crew glides slowly across the panel; the app window stays still

name: KV-B 밤의 건물
layout: dark page, headline on plain night, full-bleed night-street band with a Hopper-like building, one floor lit beside the real app window
palette: night blue-grey #0D1015, warm window light as the only warm colour
motion: windows on the lit floor switch on one by one as tickets start

name: KV-C 벽에 든 빛
layout: near-black page, headline over a photographed wall where evening window light falls to the right of the real app window
palette: near-black #0B0B0C, one amber light patch, no other colour
motion: the light patch drifts slowly across the wall over the day

name: 인계 레일
layout: 가로로 이어진 실제 산출물 다섯 장; 폰은 세로 인계
density: 낮음; 한 화면에 한 성장 사이클

name: 팀 / 내 결정
layout: 넓은 팀 작업 영역과 좁고 고정된 사람 결정 영역; 폰에서도 소유권 분리
density: 중간; 팀 작업은 풍부하고 사람 행동은 하나

name: 한 사건의 기록
layout: 하나의 문제에 판단·수정·검증·공개가 누적되는 시간 기록
type: 구조 검증 단계: 중립 산세리프+고정폭 메타
density: 중간; 읽을 수 있는 사건 기록
motion: 새 기록이 아래에 쌓이고 다음 측정으로 닫힘

name: A 한 테이크
layout: left-aligned headline+CTA, below a wide cropped product window: one ticket's 7-step activity timeline with the decision card on the eye axis; Linear-like section rhythm with legible product crops
palette: graphite neutrals #0A0A0B/#F6F6F4, amber #F2A93B only for my turn
motion: timeline steps tick in, decision card lamp breathes

name: B 밤사이 일지
layout: two-column editorial: serif headline left; right column pins the decision on top and the timestamped overnight log with artifact clippings below; ruled ledger sections
type: Newsreader + Noto Serif KR headlines and PM quote / Pretendard body / JetBrains Mono ids
palette: deep ink #0E1013 and paper white, phosphor green #4FD69C only for my turn
motion: a new log line appears, the decision lamp glows

name: C 출발 안내판
layout: full-width departures board of the squad as the hero, one row per job, only the 'you' row lit; board grammar carried through every section; board stays a dark physical panel in both themes
type: IBM Plex Sans + IBM Plex Mono / IBM Plex Sans KR
palette: pure black #070707 board, off-white page, signal yellow #FFD23F for my turn
motion: status tiles flip, one working lamp blinks
